title: Text: DET Jim Schmakel ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Everyone said to stay not one individual but he is the top guy so he had to have had some input. It wasn’t like it was a big decision made by the top guy. More like “can I (we) stay ? We would feel safer here” everyone agreed Understand?
